articles.title: PNC's Demchak vows to bring the fight from coast to coast
articles.mainIdea: PNC's Demchak vows to bring the fight from coast to coast
articles.summary: American Banker: PNC's Demchak vows to bring the fight from coast to coast. "We're coming into your market," PNC Chief Executive Bill Demchack said Friday. "If you're not coming into our market to come fight us, we're coming to your market to come fight you, and we're going to get some percentage of your market."
